CheckTitle: CTS tracker has log file integrity validation enabled
Description: **Huawei Cloud Trace Service (CTS)** trackers have **log file integrity validation** enabled to detect tampering or deletion of trace files stored in OBS.
Risk: Without **log file integrity validation**, an attacker or rogue administrator who gains access to the OBS bucket could modify or delete audit trace files undetected, compromising **forensic investigation** and **non-repudiation**.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Cloud Trace Service (CTS)** > **Tracker List**.
3. Click **Configure** on the target tracker.
4. Enable **Trace File Verification**.
5. Click **OK**.

Recommendation.Text: Enable **log file integrity validation** on all CTS trackers so trace files transferred to OBS can be verified against SHA-256 digest files.
